topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 70 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 26 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 16 common project-authored base contract(s) (authentication, erc20votesupgradeable, erc20upgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
